title: The Pentagon is using five-minute videos to speed up AI buying
teaser: The Pentagon is using five-minute videos to speed up military AI procurement, routing company pitches through a catalog that can help buyers meet competition requirements and, in some cases, sign contracts in less than a week. Tradewinds is meant to bring new vendors into a defense market the military helped narrow. But the faster the process gets, the more important it becomes to know what deals it produces—and who can see the results.
